name: Thaumaturgy: Spirit Thaumaturgy — 3 Advanced — Spirit Slave

system.description: This power allows you to master a summoned wraith. To use it, you must win a Mental Challenge against the wraith. If you win, the wraith is bound to remain and answer any questions you like, or perform any one task you require (if unwilling, the wraith might perform the task poorly). An additional use of this power can force a recently dead wraith into permanently haunting the present location, requiring a successful Mental Challenge against the target; this effect can eventually wear off at the Storyteller's discretion.
